content: # ============================================================ # RHIZOSPHERE PRIMING MODEL - shiny app # ============================================================ library(shiny) library(ggplot2) library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(gridExtra) library(scales) # ============================================================ # HELPERS: reference list for the About tab # ============================================================ ref_item <- function(authors, source, doi, note = NULL) { tags$li(HTML(paste0( htmltools::htmlEscape(authors), " ", htmltools::htmlEscape(source), " ", 'doi:', htmltools::htmlEscape(doi), '', if (!is.null(note)) paste0(". ", htmltools::htmlEscape(note)) else "." ))) } ref_group <- function(title, ...) { tagList(h5(strong(title)), tags$ul(...)) } # ============================================================ # MODEL FUNCTIONS # ============================================================ microbial_cn <- function(cn_som = 22, cn_re) { cn_base <- 5 + (14 - 5) / (1 + exp(-0.49 * (cn_som - 13.23))) cn_base + 0.15 * (cn_re - 35) } model_step <- function(state, day, c_re_mean, cn_re_mean, priming_strength, Km = 16, Km_plant = 50) { angle <- 2 * pi * (day - 1) / 60 + pi/2 c_re <- pmax(0, c_re_mean + 5 * sin(angle)) cn_re <- pmax(8, cn_re_mean + 20 * sin(angle)) n_re <- c_re / cn_re cn_som <- 22 cn_mo <- microbial_cn(cn_som, cn_re) cue <- 0.30 growth_n_limited <- n_re * cn_mo c_consumed <- growth_n_limited / cue c_excess <- pmax(0, c_re - c_consumed) if (c_excess > 0) { growth_excess <- c_excess * cue n_mined_potential <- (growth_excess / cn_mo) * priming_strength mining_factor <- pmax(0.2, Km / (state$soil_N + Km)) n_mined <- n_mined_potential * mining_factor r_nm_positive <- n_mined * cn_som n_to_soil <- n_mined * 0.5 } else { n_mined <- r_nm_positive <- mining_factor <- n_to_soil <- 0 } suppression <- if (cn_re < 35) ((35 - cn_re) / 25)^0.85 * 0.85 else 0 suppression <- pmin(1, pmax(0, suppression)) net_rpe <- r_nm_positive * (1 - suppression) * 1.52 - suppression * (c_re * 0.040) * 1.58 total_growth <- growth_n_limited + ifelse(c_excess > 0, c_excess * cue, 0) grazing_consumption <- state$C_mo * 0.095 microbial_respiration <- total_growth * (1 - cue) grazer_respiration <- grazing_consumption * 0.765 mo_new <- max(4, state$C_mo + total_growth * 0.65 - grazing_consumption) grazer_new <- max(2, state$C_grazer + grazing_consumption * 0.235 - state$C_grazer * 0.015) new_plant_C <- state$plant_C + c_re * 0.25 new_soil_N <- state$soil_N + n_to_soil + 0.005 plant_N_uptake <- new_plant_C * 0.002 * (new_soil_N / (new_soil_N + Km_plant)) new_soil_N <- pmax(0.1, new_soil_N - plant_N_uptake) cum_net_c_add <- c_re - microbial_respiration - grazer_respiration - net_rpe list(net_rpe = net_rpe, cum_net_c_add = cum_net_c_add, c_re = c_re, cn_re = cn_re, C_mo = mo_new, C_grazer = grazer_new, soil_N = new_soil_N, plant_N_uptake = plant_N_uptake, plant_C = new_plant_C, microbial_growth = total_growth, grazing_consumption = grazing_consumption, microbial_respiration = microbial_respiration, grazer_respiration = grazer_respiration) } # ============================================================ # HELPER: Run full simulation (returns sim df + metrics) # ============================================================ run_full_simulation <- function(c_re_mean, cn_re_mean, priming_strength = 1.92, Km = 16, Km_plant = 50, init_C_mo = 8, init_C_grazer = 6, init_soil_N = 15, init_plant_C = 20, sim_days = 300) { state <- list(C_mo = init_C_mo, C_grazer = init_C_grazer, soil_N = init_soil_N, plant_C = init_plant_C) sim <- data.frame(day = 1:sim_days) sim$net_rpe <- sim$cum_net_c <- sim$c_re <- sim$cn_re <- 0 sim$C_mo <- sim$C_grazer <- sim$soil_N <- sim$plant_N_uptake <- sim$plant_C <- 0 sim$microbial_growth <- sim$grazing_consumption <- sim$microbial_respiration <- sim$grazer_respiration <- 0 cum_net_c <- 0 for (d in 1:sim_days) { out <- model_step(state, d, c_re_mean, cn_re_mean, priming_strength, Km = Km, Km_plant = Km_plant) state <- list(C_mo = out$C_mo, C_grazer = out$C_grazer, soil_N = out$soil_N, plant_C = out$plant_C) cum_net_c <- cum_net_c + out$cum_net_c_add sim$net_rpe[d] <- out$net_rpe sim$cum_net_c[d] <- cum_net_c sim$c_re[d] <- out$c_re sim$cn_re[d] <- out$cn_re sim$C_mo[d] <- out$C_mo sim$C_grazer[d] <- out$C_grazer sim$soil_N[d] <- out$soil_N sim$plant_N_uptake[d] <- out$plant_N_uptake sim$plant_C[d] <- out$plant_C sim$microbial_growth[d] <- out$microbial_growth sim$grazing_consumption[d] <- out$grazing_consumption sim$microbial_respiration[d] <- out$microbial_respiration sim$grazer_respiration[d] <- out$grazer_respiration } mean_rpe <- mean(sim$net_rpe, na.rm = TRUE) min_rpe <- min(sim$net_rpe, na.rm = TRUE) max_rpe <- max(sim$net_rpe, na.rm = TRUE) final_c <- tail(sim$cum_net_c, 1) metrics <- data.frame( c_re_mean = c_re_mean, cn_re_mean = cn_re_mean, Km = Km, Km_plant = Km_plant, priming_strength = priming_strength, Mean_RPE = round(mean_rpe, 3), Min_RPE = round(min_rpe, 3), Max_RPE = round(max_rpe, 3), Final_Net_C_balance = round(final_c, 2), stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) list(sim = sim, metrics = metrics) } # ============================================================ # PRESET SCENARIOS (with intended Km / Km_plant) # ============================================================ presets <- list( "Mostly Positive" = list( name = "Mostly_positive", c_re_mean = 10, cn_re_mean = 43, Km = 6, Km_plant = 90, priming_strength = 1.92 ), "Net RPE Balanced" = list( name = "NetRPE_balanced", c_re_mean = 19, cn_re_mean = 42, Km = 30, Km_plant = 50, priming_strength = 1.92 ), "Symmetric Equal" = list( name = "Symmetric_equal", c_re_mean = 25, cn_re_mean = 40, Km = 35, Km_plant = 48, priming_strength = 1.92 ), "Mostly Negative" = list( name = "Mostly_negative", c_re_mean = 15, cn_re_mean = 38, Km = 60, Km_plant = 45, priming_strength = 1.92 ) ) # ============================================================ # UI # ============================================================ ui <- navbarPage( "Rhizosphere Priming Effect (RPE) Model", # ---------- TAB 1: SINGLE SIMULATION ---------- tabPanel("Single Simulation", sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( width = 3, h4("Exudate Inputs"), sliderInput("c_re_mean", "Mean daily C exudation (µg C g⁻¹ soil d⁻¹)", min = 5, max = 100, value = 19, step = 1), sliderInput("cn_re_mean", "Mean exudate C:N ratio", min = 5, max = 60, value = 42, step = 1), hr(), h4("Process Parameters"), sliderInput("priming_strength", "Priming strength multiplier", min = 0.5, max = 3.0, value = 1.92, step = 0.01), sliderInput("Km", "Km — microbial N-mining half-saturation", min = 1, max = 100, value = 30, step = 1), sliderInput("Km_plant", "Km_plant — plant N-uptake half-saturation", min = 1, max = 100, value = 50, step = 1), hr(), h4("Initial Conditions"), numericInput("init_C_mo", "Initial microbial biomass C", value = 8, min = 1, step = 1), numericInput("init_C_grazer", "Initial grazer biomass C", value = 6, min = 1, step = 1), numericInput("init_soil_N", "Initial soil mineral N", value = 15, min = 0.1, step = 0.5), numericInput("init_plant_C", "Initial plant C pool", value = 20, min = 1, step = 1), numericInput("sim_days", "Simulation length (days)", value = 300, min = 100, max = 1000, step = 50), hr(), actionButton("run_sim", "▶ Run Simulation", class = "btn-primary btn-lg", width = "100%"), hr(), h4("Quick Presets"), fluidRow( column(6, actionButton("preset1", "Mostly +", class = "btn-success btn-sm", width = "100%")), column(6, actionButton("preset2", "Balanced", class = "btn-info btn-sm", width = "100%")) ), br(), fluidRow( column(6, actionButton("preset3", "Symmetric", class = "btn-warning btn-sm", width = "100%")), column(6, actionButton("preset4", "Mostly −", class = "btn-danger btn-sm", width = "100%")) ), hr(), downloadButton("dl_sim_csv", "Download simulation data (.csv)", class = "btn-outline-primary btn-sm"), br(), br(), downloadButton("dl_rpe_pdf", "Download current RPE plot (.pdf)", class = "btn-outline-primary btn-sm") ), mainPanel( width = 9, tabsetPanel( tabPanel("Key Metrics", br(), fluidRow( column(3, wellPanel(h5("Mean Net RPE"), h3(textOutput("val_mean_rpe")), style = "text-align:center;")), column(3, wellPanel(h5("Min Net RPE"), h3(textOutput("val_min_rpe")), style = "text-align:center;")), column(3, wellPanel(h5("Max Net RPE"), h3(textOutput("val_max_rpe")), style = "text-align:center;")), column(3, wellPanel(h5("Final Net C Balance"), h3(textOutput("val_final_c")), style = "text-align:center;")) ), br(), h4("Simulation Summary"), tableOutput("metrics_table"), hr(), p(em("Net RPE > 0 indicates net positive priming (more soil C loss). Net RPE < 0 indicates net suppression or C stabilization.")) ), tabPanel("RPE & Carbon Balance", plotOutput("plot_rpe", height = "320px"), plotOutput("plot_balance", height = "320px") ), tabPanel("Biomass & Fluxes", plotOutput("plot_biomass", height = "320px"), plotOutput("plot_fluxes", height = "320px") ), tabPanel("Soil N & Diagnostics", plotOutput("plot_soilN", height = "320px"), plotOutput("plot_diagnostics", height = "320px") ), tabPanel("Full 8-Panel View", plotOutput("plot_full", height = "950px") ) ) ) ) ), # ---------- TAB 2: SCENARIO COMPARISON ---------- tabPanel("Scenario Comparison", fluidPage( h3("Compare the four targeted scenarios from the original study"), actionButton("run_compare", "Run / Refresh All Four Scenarios", class = "btn-primary"), br(), br(), plotOutput("plot_compare_2x2", height = "620px"), br(), h4("Scenario Metrics Summary"), tableOutput("compare_table") ) ), # ---------- TAB 3: SENSITIVITY (Km × Km_plant) ---------- tabPanel("Sensitivity Explorer (Km × Km_plant)", sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( width = 3, h4("Base Scenario"), selectInput("sens_preset", "Choose base preset", choices = names(presets), selected = "Net RPE Balanced"), helpText("The selected preset sets c_re_mean, cn_re_mean and priming_strength. Km and Km_plant are varied in the grid below."), hr(), h4("Grid Settings"), sliderInput("sens_km_min", "Km minimum", min = 1, max = 50, value = 1, step = 5), sliderInput("sens_km_max", "Km maximum", min = 10, max = 101, value = 101, step = 5), sliderInput("sens_kmp_min", "Km_plant minimum", min = 1, max = 50, value = 1, step = 5), sliderInput("sens_kmp_max", "Km_plant maximum", min = 10, max = 101, value = 101, step = 5), sliderInput("sens_step", "Step size (resolution)", min = 2, max = 10, value = 5, step = 1), hr(), actionButton("run_sens", "Run Sensitivity Grid", class = "btn-success btn-lg", width = "100%"), br(), br(), helpText("A 21×21 grid (step=5) runs in < 2 seconds. Larger grids are also fast."), downloadButton("dl_sens_csv", "Download sensitivity results (.csv)") ), mainPanel( width = 9, tabsetPanel( tabPanel("Mean RPE Heatmap", plotOutput("sens_heatmap_rpe", height = "650px") ), tabPanel("Final C Balance Heatmap", plotOutput("sens_heatmap_cbal", height = "650px") ), tabPanel("Results Table (top 20)", tableOutput("sens_table") ) ) ) ) ), # ---------- TAB 4: ABOUT ---------- tabPanel("About / Instructions", fluidPage( h2("Rhizosphere Priming Effect (RPE) Interactive Explorer"), p("This Shiny app lets you interactively explore a mechanistic model of rhizosphere priming, microbial N-mining, plant N-uptake competition, and grazer dynamics."), h4("How to use"), tags$ol( tags$li(strong("Single Simulation tab:"), "Adjust sliders or click a preset, then press 'Run Simulation'. Explore the different plot tabs."), tags$li(strong("Scenario Comparison tab:"), "Run all four classic scenarios side-by-side (2×2 RPE time series + summary table)."), tags$li(strong("Sensitivity Explorer:"), "Pick a base scenario and vary microbial Km and plant Km_plant across a grid to see how they control mean RPE and net C balance (heatmaps)."), tags$li("All plots and data can be downloaded.") ), h4("Key Parameters"), tags$ul( tags$li(strong("c_re_mean / cn_re_mean:"), "Average daily root exudate C input and its C:N ratio (seasonal sine wave added internally)."), tags$li(strong("Km:"), "Controls how strongly microbes mine soil organic N when mineral N is low (lower Km = stronger mining response at low N)."), tags$li(strong("Km_plant:"), "Controls plant competitive strength for mineral N (lower Km_plant = stronger plant uptake)."), tags$li(strong("priming_strength:"), "Multiplier on potential N mining from excess C."), tags$li(strong("Net RPE:"), "Net rhizosphere priming effect on soil C (positive = net loss of soil C, negative = net gain/stabilization).") ), hr(), h4("Key references"), ref_group("Model basis", ref_item("Michel (2026)", "Biol Fertil Soils 62: 935–955.", "10.1007/s00374-026-02021-8"), ref_item("Chertov et al. (2022)", "Plants 11: 2605.", "10.3390/plants11192605") ), ref_group("Priming concept", ref_item("Kuzyakov, Friedel & Stahr (2000)", "Soil Biol Biochem 32: 1485–1498.", "10.1016/s0038-0717(00)00084-5"), ref_item("Cheng et al. (2014)", "New Phytol 201: 31–44.", "10.1111/nph.12440") ), ref_group("N mining, the Km term", ref_item("Craine, Morrow & Fierer (2007)", "Ecology 88: 2105–2113.", "10.1890/06-1847.1"), ref_item("Chen et al. (2014)", "Glob Change Biol 20: 2356–2367.", "10.1111/gcb.12475"), ref_item("Dijkstra et al. (2013)", "Front Microbiol 4.", "10.3389/fmicb.2013.00216") ), ref_group("Negative priming", ref_item("Blagodatskaya & Kuzyakov (2008)", "Biol Fertil Soils 45: 115–131.", "10.1007/s00374-008-0334-y"), ref_item("Michel et al. (2023)", "Biogeochemistry 162: 141–161.", "10.1007/s10533-022-00996-8") ), ref_group("Microbial CUE and C:N", ref_item("Manzoni et al. (2012)", "New Phytol 196: 79–91.", "10.1111/j.1469-8137.2012.04225.x"), ref_item("Mooshammer et al. (2014)", "Front Microbiol 5.", "10.3389/fmicb.2014.00022") ), ref_group("Plant–microbe N competition", ref_item("Kuzyakov & Xu (2013)", "New Phytol 198: 656–669.", "10.1111/nph.12235"), ref_item("Hodge, Robinson & Fitter (2000)", "Trends Plant Sci 5: 304–308.", "10.1016/S1360-1385(00)01656-3") ), ref_group("Grazers and the microbial loop", ref_item("Clarholm (1985)", "Soil Biol Biochem 17: 181–187.", "10.1016/0038-0717(85)90113-0"), ref_item("Bonkowski (2004)", "New Phytol 162: 617–631.", "10.1111/j.1469-8137.2004.01066.x") ), ref_group("Earlier priming models", ref_item("Blagodatsky et al. (2010)", "Soil Biol Biochem 42: 1275–1283.", "10.1016/j.soilbio.2010.04.005"), ref_item("Wutzler & Reichstein (2013)", "Biogeosciences 10: 2089–2103.", "10.5194/bg-10-2089-2013") ) ) ) ) # ============================================================ # SERVER # ============================================================ server <- function(input, output, session) { # Reactive value to store latest single-run results rv <- reactiveValues( sim = NULL, metrics = NULL, last_params = NULL ) # ---- Run simulation when button pressed ---- observeEvent(input$run_sim, { res <- run_full_simulation( c_re_mean = input$c_re_mean, cn_re_mean = input$cn_re_mean, priming_strength = input$priming_strength, Km = input$Km, Km_plant = input$Km_plant, init_C_mo = input$init_C_mo, init_C_grazer = input$init_C_grazer, init_soil_N = input$init_soil_N, init_plant_C = input$init_plant_C, sim_days = input$sim_days ) rv$sim <- res$sim rv$metrics <- res$metrics rv$last_params <- list( c_re_mean = input$c_re_mean, cn_re_mean = input$cn_re_mean, Km = input$Km, Km_plant = input$Km_plant, priming_strength = input$priming_strength ) }) # ---- Preset buttons: update UI + run simulation directly ---- observeEvent(input$preset1, { p <- presets[["Mostly Positive"]] updateSliderInput(session, "c_re_mean", value = p$c_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "cn_re_mean", value = p$cn_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "Km", value = p$Km) updateSliderInput(session, "Km_plant", value = p$Km_plant) updateSliderInput(session, "priming_strength", value = p$priming_strength) res <- run_full_simulation(p$c_re_mean, p$cn_re_mean, p$priming_strength, p$Km, p$Km_plant) rv$sim <- res$sim rv$metrics <- res$metrics rv$last_params <- p }) observeEvent(input$preset2, { p <- presets[["Net RPE Balanced"]] updateSliderInput(session, "c_re_mean", value = p$c_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "cn_re_mean", value = p$cn_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "Km", value = p$Km) updateSliderInput(session, "Km_plant", value = p$Km_plant) updateSliderInput(session, "priming_strength", value = p$priming_strength) res <- run_full_simulation(p$c_re_mean, p$cn_re_mean, p$priming_strength, p$Km, p$Km_plant) rv$sim <- res$sim rv$metrics <- res$metrics rv$last_params <- p }) observeEvent(input$preset3, { p <- presets[["Symmetric Equal"]] updateSliderInput(session, "c_re_mean", value = p$c_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "cn_re_mean", value = p$cn_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "Km", value = p$Km) updateSliderInput(session, "Km_plant", value = p$Km_plant) updateSliderInput(session, "priming_strength", value = p$priming_strength) res <- run_full_simulation(p$c_re_mean, p$cn_re_mean, p$priming_strength, p$Km, p$Km_plant) rv$sim <- res$sim rv$metrics <- res$metrics rv$last_params <- p }) observeEvent(input$preset4, { p <- presets[["Mostly Negative"]] updateSliderInput(session, "c_re_mean", value = p$c_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "cn_re_mean", value = p$cn_re_mean) updateSliderInput(session, "Km", value = p$Km) updateSliderInput(session, "Km_plant", value = p$Km_plant) updateSliderInput(session, "priming_strength", value = p$priming_strength) res <- run_full_simulation(p$c_re_mean, p$cn_re_mean, p$priming_strength, p$Km, p$Km_plant) rv$sim <- res$sim rv$metrics <- res$metrics rv$last_params <- p }) # ---- Reactive plot builders (used by multiple outputs) ---- theme_custom <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) make_rpe_plot <- function(sim) { ggplot(sim, aes(day, net_rpe)) + geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1.3) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) + labs(x = "Day", y = "Net RPE") + theme_custom } make_balance_plot <- function(sim) { ggplot(sim, aes(day, cum_net_c)) + geom_line(color = "#2ca02c", linewidth = 1.3) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) + labs(x = "Day", y = "Cumulative Net C Balance") + theme_custom } make_biomass_plot <- function(sim) { data_biomass <- sim %>% select(day, C_mo, C_grazer) %>% pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "value") ggplot(data_biomass, aes(day, value, color = compartment)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + scale_color_manual(values = c("C_mo" = "#d62728", "C_grazer" = "#ff7f0e"), labels = c("Microbial C", "Grazer C")) + labs(x = "Day", y = "Biomass C (µg g⁻¹)", color = NULL) + theme_custom } make_flux_plot <- function(sim) { data_flux <- sim %>% select(day, microbial_growth, grazing_consumption, microbial_respiration, grazer_respiration) %>% pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "flux", values_to = "value") ggplot(data_flux, aes(day, value, color = flux)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + scale_color_manual(values = c("microbial_growth" = "#1f77b4", "grazing_consumption" = "#9467bd", "microbial_respiration" = "#d62728", "grazer_respiration" = "#ff7f0e"), labels = c("Microbial growth", "Grazing consumption", "Microbial respiration", "Grazer respiration")) + labs(x = "Day", y = "C flux (µg g⁻¹ d⁻¹)", color = NULL) + theme_custom } make_soilN_plot <- function(sim) { data_soil <- sim %>% select(day, soil_N, plant_N_uptake) %>% pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") ggplot(data_soil, aes(day, value, color = variable)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + scale_color_manual(values = c("soil_N" = "#2ca02c", "plant_N_uptake" = "#1f77b4"), labels = c("Soil mineral N", "Plant N uptake")) + labs(x = "Day", y = "N (µg g⁻¹ or µg g⁻¹ d⁻¹)", color = NULL) + theme_custom } make_diagnostics_plot <- function(sim) { data_diag <- sim %>% mutate(cn_mo = microbial_cn(22, cn_re)) p1 <- ggplot(data_diag, aes(day, cn_mo)) + geom_line(color = "#9467bd", linewidth = 1.2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 22, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50") + labs(x = "Day", y = "Microbial C:N") + theme_custom p2 <- ggplot(data_diag, aes(day, cn_re)) + geom_line(color = "#d62728", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") + geom_hline(yintercept = 35, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50") + labs(x = "Day", y = "Exudate C:N") + theme_custom grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1) } # ---- Outputs for Single Simulation tab ---- output$val_mean_rpe <- renderText({ req(rv$metrics) rv$metrics$Mean_RPE }) output$val_min_rpe <- renderText({ req(rv$metrics) rv$metrics$Min_RPE }) output$val_max_rpe <- renderText({ req(rv$metrics) rv$metrics$Max_RPE }) output$val_final_c <- renderText({ req(rv$metrics) rv$metrics$Final_Net_C_balance }) output$metrics_table <- renderTable({ req(rv$metrics) rv$metrics }, rownames = FALSE, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE) output$plot_rpe <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) make_rpe_plot(rv$sim) }) output$plot_balance <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) make_balance_plot(rv$sim) }) output$plot_biomass <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) make_biomass_plot(rv$sim) }) output$plot_fluxes <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) make_flux_plot(rv$sim) }) output$plot_soilN <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) make_soilN_plot(rv$sim) }) output$plot_diagnostics <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) make_diagnostics_plot(rv$sim) }) output$plot_full <- renderPlot({ req(rv$sim) sim <- rv$sim data_rpe <- data.frame(day = sim$day, net_rpe = sim$net_rpe) data_biomass <- sim %>% select(day, C_mo, C_grazer) %>% pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "value") data_flux <- sim %>% select(day, microbial_growth, grazing_consumption, microbial_respiration, grazer_respiration) %>% pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "flux", values_to = "value") data_soilN <- sim %>% select(day, soil_N, plant_N_uptake) %>% pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") data_balance <- data.frame(day = sim$day, cum_net_c = sim$cum_net_c) data_exudates <- sim %>% select(day, c_re, cn_re) %>% mutate(n_from_exudates = c_re / cn_re) data_diagnostic <- sim %>% mutate(cn_mo = microbial_cn(22, cn_re)) p1 <- ggplot(data_rpe, aes(day, net_rpe)) + geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1.4) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + labs(y = "Net RPE", x = NULL) + theme_custom p2 <- ggplot(data_biomass, aes(day, value, color = compartment)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) + scale_color_manual(values = c("C_mo" = "#d62728", "C_grazer" =
